title: Nirvana Fallacy Explained: Why Perfection Blocks Progress
description:
We all dream of perfect solutions. But when we reject good, practical answers because they aren’t flawless, we fall into the Nirvana Fallacy — also called the Perfectionist Fallacy or Perfect Solution Fallacy.

In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts explains the form of the Nirvana Fallacy and why it’s so common in real life. From anti-vaxxers rejecting vaccines because they aren’t 100% safe, to mask deniers saying masks don’t offer complete protection, to climate change deniers dismissing renewable energy because it’s not perfect — this fallacy fuels bad decisions.

We also look at how people misuse it against self-driving cars, science-based medicine, and drunk-driving campaigns. Rejecting progress because it isn’t perfect often means settling for worse alternatives.

If you’ve searched for Nirvana Fallacy explained, perfectionist fallacy, why people chase perfect solutions, anti-vaccine fallacy, climate change denial arguments, or logical fallacies debunked, this video breaks it down in simple terms.
